title: Enhanced room-temperature hydrogen storage capacity in Pt-loaded graphene oxide/HKUST-1 composites
material_description: PG | Pt-loaded graphene oxide (Pt@GO): GO from natural flake graphite (Qingdao Guyu Graphite, 150 um, 99.9%) by a modified Hummers method, Pt nanoparticles deposited by ethylene-glycol reduction of H2PtCl6 at 100 C for 6 h; Pt 18.9 wt% by EDS
purification_method: GO: washed with 5% HCl until sulfate-free, redispersed in DI water and dialyzed 3 days, dried in vacuum oven at 60 C for 24 h; PG: centrifuged, washed with DI water three times, dried in oven at 60 C for 12 h
functional_groups: carboxyl (IR band ~1700 cm-1, weaker than in GO); oxygen-containing groups (EDS O signal)
source_location: Main article p. 2164 (main-5), Fig. 6 (low-pressure H2 isotherms at 77 K), series PG (black circles)
notes: archive: fig6_PG.json. Basis not named; ASAP 2020 (Micromeritics) low-pressure H2 isotherm, coded volumetric_sieverts, basis_inferred by instrumental default. Degassing: 'The GO and PG samples were outgassed at 80 C' (duration not stated for PG; the 24 h / 150 mg statement is for HPG0 and composites). Pt 18.9 wt% from EDS/element mapping of PG (Fig. S6). No surface area or pore volume is reported for PG (text: 'PG exhibited a significantly low and negligible porosity'; Table S2 lists HPG0, HPG5, HPG10 only). surface_area_method coded none: the paper's only areas (Table S2) are for HPG0 (HKUST-1) and the HKUST-1-majority composites, none of which are carbon sorbents or rows here; for PG it is not_reported in the paper's sense, but the validator requires none because no row of this paper carries an area.
